name: protendai/nativephp-billing
description: In-app purchases for NativePHP Mobile v4: Google Play Billing 8 on Android and StoreKit 2 on iOS. Subscriptions (base plans, free trials, intro offers, upgrades) and one-time products (consumable and non-consumable), with purchase tokens and signed transactions for server-side verification.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Products
bridge_functions.description: Load subscription or one-time products with prices, plans and offers. Async: ProductsLoaded.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Purchase
bridge_functions.description: Open the Google Play or App Store purchase sheet for a subscription or a one-time product. Async: PurchaseUpdated.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Restore
bridge_functions.description: List what the Google or Apple account owns now (active subscriptions, unconsumed one-time products). Async: PurchasesRestored.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Acknowledge
bridge_functions.description: Acknowledge a purchase (Android, apps without a server) or finish its transaction (iOS). Async: PurchaseAcknowledged.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Consume
bridge_functions.description: Consume a one-time purchase so it can be bought again (iOS: finish it). Async: PurchaseConsumed.
